name: Handy
description: Dictation by Handy, the free open-source speech-to-text app (MIT, handy.computer): Whisper or Parakeet on this computer. Installing it downloads the official Handy 0.10.2 MSI for Windows x64 (31 MB, sha256-pinned) and unpacks it into Orkestri's own folder: nothing is installed on the computer. Settings > General > Voice > Dictation then offers Handy: the microphone button records and Handy pastes the text into the terminal's field. Not made or endorsed by Handy's authors.
